$Comments.$text:
Land.maximum

Value is the absolute terrain height cap (cliff_max_y). It limits peaks; it does not set the average island height.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

Coast.radius

Value is the flat-island radius. Cliff radius is (flat_radius + cliff_radius_bonus) * cliff_horizontal_scale. At scale 0.6, cliff footprints are approximately 40% smaller in X/Z; flat islands keep their radius.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

IslandGroups.N2.spacing

group_spacing controls distance between GROUP centres; group_jitter makes their placement less regular. Larger spacing creates wider open-ocean gaps. Each membership branch must use the same distributor settings.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

IslandGroups.N2.members

cell_spacing sets the nominal distance between neighbouring ISLAND centres (currently 260 blocks). member_jitter adds small local offsets. Coast-to-coast gaps also depend on island radius and coast deformation; 40-120 blocks is a target, not a hard constraint.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

IslandGroups.centers

group_min_islands / group_max_islands select the number of centres per group (currently 2-6). Rebuild after changing these settings: each count uses its own native cluster branch. solitary_group_fraction reserves some group sites for one island. Coast deformation can still merge nearby land.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

Coast.shape.warp

WarpFactor increases coastline displacement. WarpScale controls the size of bends: larger means broader bays. Keep the matching Cliff / IslandKind / IslandRadius warps in sync; prefer terrain-settings.json.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

Coast.cells

This field measures distance to the shared IslandCenters positions. MaxDistance = 2 * cell_spacing preserves the normalized distance used by the terrain. Do not change MaxDistance alone to resize islands.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

PhantomPaint.IA.Coast.xz

YOverride normalizes the cache key only for fields proven independent of height. Cache Capacity limits stored exact values; it does not change noise resolution or terrain detail. Imports retain separate caches and their original seed contexts. Do not enable SingleInstance: nested props can use different parent seeds.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

Cliff.kind

Cell values above the curve threshold select cliff islands. Lower the threshold to get more cliff islands. Prefer cliff_fraction in terrain-settings.json to update related masks together.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

FlatIsland.profile

Curve In is distance from the coast; Out is terrain height. beach_width controls the gentle coastal section. Keep underwater shelf points at the intended 6-10 block depths.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

CliffCoast3D.distance

cliff_overhang is 7. The patch mask selects about 5-7 blocks of outward displacement in active areas. The height-band curve keeps the rock foot in place and moves upper layers over the water. Actual horizontal extent varies with coastline distortion.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

CliffIsland.shelf

Curve In is distance inland; Out is surface Y. cliff_wall_run spreads the main rise over 4 coast-field units. Larger values soften the wall. Separate 3D weathering breaks up straight walls; overhangs still shift upper sections outward.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

CliffCoast3D.roughness

cliff_wall_roughness controls small horizontal wall displacements that vary with height. Keep it low to avoid thin rock needles. ScaleXZ / ScaleY on weatherNoise control horizontal / vertical feature size.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

CliffIsland.accessProfile

Low Out values near the coast preserve beach access. Raise inland Out values for steeper climbs; move their In positions farther apart for gentler slopes.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

CliffAccess.primaryWidth

These angular corridors originate at each island centre instead of relying on a global noise contour hitting the island. Cell identity varies their orientation; coastline warp bends them. Widen the high part for wider ramp floors, or move the zero outward for gentler side slopes. This is terrain construction, not a block-level navigation proof.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

CliffAccess.channels

The flat high part of this curve selects access corridors. Widen it to create broader entrances. The same exported field also thins vegetation along the access routes.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

Land.reliefAmplitude

Increase Value for stronger small hills; decrease for smoother ground. Controlled by land_relief_height.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

Land.outcropRegions

Raise the positive-selection thresholds to create fewer rocky plateau areas. land_region_scale changes the size of the areas, not the height.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

Land.outcropShape

The upper flat Out value is added height (land_outcrop_height). Larger land_detail_scale creates broader plateaus. Lower the Out plateau to reduce local elevation differences.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

Land.cliffWaves

cliff_upland_relief controls broad height differences on cliff islands only. Their relief mask now reaches full strength much nearer the coast, so smaller islands also have uneven tops. Relief is reduced on access ramps; cliff_max_y still caps the result.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

Ocean.trenchDepth

This amplitude is negative: more negative values deepen trenches. trench_depth is entered as a positive depth in settings.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

Ocean.plateauShape

Positive Out values lift the seabed inside selected rock regions. ocean_plateau_height controls the lift; ocean_rock_region_scale controls region size.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

CaveAxes.mainPath.warp

Higher WarpFactor adds stronger bends; WarpScale controls bend size. The second path field creates branches. Settings: tunnel_warp_distance and tunnel_shape_scale.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

CaveVoid.width

Amplitude is 1 / tunnel_noise_width. Lower this node Value for wider tunnels. In settings, increase tunnel_noise_width. Passage protection is rebuilt to match.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

CaveVoid.height

Amplitude is 1 / tunnel_half_height. Lower this Value for taller cavities. Keep the flood limit below sea level; tunnel_half_height is the easier setting.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

LakeLevel

The two Constants are flat/cliff lake water Y. Lower the matching terrain and water levels together. LakeSelection requires supporting terrain above the water plane.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

ReefBed.patches

Lower coral_patch_threshold to expand reef regions. marine_region_scale selects broad habitats; coral_patch_scale shapes smaller patches. The same mask controls reef rock and corals.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

CoastalRock.steepOnly

Steep surfaces on cliff islands receive marble, including gorge sides. Flat tops keep grass and access floors keep soil/sand. Lowering the angle thresholds can bring back flat marble aprons.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

BeachTop.mean

Value sets the mean sand-to-grass transition height. BeachTop.variation adds spatial variation. This changes materials, not sea level.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

Paths.trailLine

Widen the low-input high-output section for wider paths. trail_half_width_noise controls this width. Trails and bare patches use Soil_Dirt_Lush.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

GroundCover.dampSoil

Existing dirt patches and paths remain. mud_patch_threshold selects their wetter Soil_Mud subregions using a separate 2D field. Lower values replace more of the existing bare-soil area with mud.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

GroundCover.moss

moss_patch_threshold selects connected Plant_Moss_Block_Green patches in the existing grass surface layer. Lower values increase coverage. The original dirt/path mask takes priority; island density and layer thickness stay unchanged.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

JungleRoots.variants

jungle_root_chance is 0.60 before fit checks. Small and medium roots try both trunk widths in the same direction. Soft soil may cover roots on gentle slopes; ends can emerge one block above solid support. Existing wood is never replaced. Landmark roots still require wider trunks; coast and access guards remain.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

$Comments.$name: Leaf soil under real jungle trees
$Comments.$text:
JungleLeafSoil.chance

jungle_leaf_patch_chance controls patch attempts after a real jungle trunk is detected. Small local ground scanners replace surface soil with Soil_Leaves_Full, following two-block terrain changes. Palm placement does not run this branch.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

Jungle.accessKeep

The access curve removes most trees and bushes on cliff ramps. The occasionalPlants branch allows exceptions on the shoulders only; protectedCore excludes them from the ramp core. Large rock footprints also reject the core.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

JunglePonds.scale

jungle_pond_spacing controls sparse candidate spacing. Larger inland forest areas are required. Each variant checks its entire foundation and clear space before carving a bounded organic basin. Manual Empty + Water_Source replaces soil; this is not water on top of grass. Existing lakes and island density are retained.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

Runtime0.union

Runtime 0 places rocks, coral structures, marble rubble and hardwood decks. Runtime 1 places trees on solid ground. Runtime 2 places bushes/ferns with space checks. Runtime 3 adds small plants to the remaining empty blocks.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

CoastalTidePools.scale

tide_pool_spacing controls candidate spacing. Region threshold -0.35 allows more coastal patches. Water checks include diagonals; marble neighbours can be below or above the beach. Sea level, full foundation and dry footprint checks remain mandatory. Lower spacing adds candidates and generation work.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

BeachPebbles.block

Places Rubble_Marble in the empty block above white sand. It does not replace the sand with gravel or Soil_Pebbles. beach_pebble_spacing controls candidate spacing.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

Bridges.X17.pattern

Three blocks wide, no railings. Both landings need solid ground; the deck and headroom must be empty and a real gap must exist below the centre. Lower bridge_spacing adds candidates, not guaranteed bridges. X/Z variants cross different gorge directions.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

Corals.H2.scanner

MaxExclusive is one block above the highest allowed anchor. coral_top_y caps the TOP of each prefab, not just its anchor. Taller variants get lower anchor limits automatically.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

Corals.H5.passages

Every footprint column is still checked. Native AND/OR predicates short-circuit the original min/max range test: cheap tunnel/arch noise can settle the result before expensive island-centre searches. The interval remains [0.001, 10000); protected swimming passages and prefab sizes are unchanged. Builder: optimize_passages.py.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

BerryBushes.scale

berry_bush_spacing controls candidate spacing; smaller values add more bushes. BerryBushes.patches selects natural groups on grassy ground. Native Plant_Crop_Berry_Block retains normal growth and harvesting. Placement follows trees, checks a clear 3x3 footprint and excludes ramp cores.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

Bushes.scale

Increase bush_spacing to reduce bush candidates. Spacing 10 gives about 44% more candidates than 12. Full prefab bounds must be empty after trees have been placed; access ramps remain sparse.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

TropicalPlants.Flower_Common_Orange2.scale

This native flower requires side support. Its rotated placement checks adjacent jungle wood or marble as well as suitable ground. Other tropical plants have their own shared colour-region masks and taller variants reserve more headroom.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

Flowers.OrchidPink.scale

Lower flower_spacing for more orchids. Shared colour noise selects local variants; the floor rule keeps flowers off dirt paths.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

SeaweedForest.H21.scale

Smaller X/Z Scale means denser candidate placement. Halving spacing gives about four times as many candidates, before habitat checks. Setting: seaweed_forest_spacing.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

SeaweedForest.H21.column

Each Manual block adds one vertical stack segment. Every segment retains Water_Source. The water-column pattern must be tall enough to contain the whole plant.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.

CaveRegion.selection

Increase the threshold Constant to select fewer cave areas. tunnel_region_scale controls regional size; it does not set passage width.

Builder runs overwrite manual graph edits. Use the settings file for persistent tuning.
